versions.document:
---
type: requirement
id: relay-answers-requests
kind: behavior
text:
  - The relay answers each request that it receives.

---
type: requirement
id: relay-answers-in-time
kind: behavior
parent: relay-answers-requests
text:
  - The relay answers a request within the time that the request names.

---
type: check
id: relay-answers-within-the-limit
serves: relay-answers-in-time
subject: code
procedure: program
test:
  runner: go
  selector: github.com/sjawhar/envoy/cmd/listener TestTheRelayAnswersWithinTheLimit
  job: go-checks
time_limit: 24h0m0s
claim: The relay answers a request that names one second within one second.
procedure_text:
  - The program sends one request that names one second.
  - It must get the answer within one second.
failing_example:
  - A relay that waits two seconds before each answer.

---
type: requirement
id: relay-answers-on-each-platform
kind: behavior
parent: relay-answers-requests
text:
  - The relay answers each request on Linux machines and on Arm machines.

---
type: check
id: relay-answers-on-linux-and-arm
serves: relay-answers-on-each-platform
subject: code
procedure: program
test:
  runner: go
  selector: github.com/sjawhar/envoy/cmd/listener TestTheRelayAnswersOnEachPlatform
  job: go-checks-platforms
claim: The relay answers one request on each machine of the job.
procedure_text:
  - The program sends one request to the relay and reads the answer.
  - It must get one answer.
failing_example:
  - A relay that stops before it answers.

---
type: requirement
id: relay-answers-once
kind: behavior
parent: relay-answers-requests
text:
  - The relay sends one answer for each request.

---
type: check
id: relay-answers-once-per-request
serves: relay-answers-once
subject: code
procedure: program
test:
  runner: go
  selector: github.com/sjawhar/envoy/cmd/listener TestTheRelayAnswersOnce
  job: go-checks
claim: The relay sends one answer to a request that it receives two times.
procedure_text:
  - The program sends one request two times and counts the answers.
  - It must count one answer.
failing_example:
  - A relay that answers each copy of a request.

---
type: requirement
id: relay-refuses-a-bad-request
kind: behavior
parent: relay-answers-requests
text:
  - The relay refuses a request that it cannot read.

---
type: check
id: relay-refuses-a-malformed-request
serves: relay-refuses-a-bad-request
subject: code
procedure: program
test:
  runner: go
  selector: github.com/sjawhar/envoy/cmd/listener TestTheRelayRefusesAMalformedRequest
  job: go-checks
claim: The relay refuses a request whose body is not valid.
procedure_text:
  - The program sends one request with a body that is not valid.
  - It must get a refusal.
failing_example:
  - A relay that answers a request with a body that is not valid.
